You've Reached Sam is a contemporary work by Dustin Thao (2021).

Heartbroken seventeen-year-old Julie calls her deceased boyfriend's cellphone just to hear his voicemail, but Sam picks up the phone.

Categorized under: YA, Fantasy, Romance, Drama.
